summary: Thunder Bridge Capital Partners V, a blank-check company that completed its 30,015,000-unit IPO on August 14, 2026, filed an 8-K announcing that starting October 5, 2026, holders may separately trade the Class A ordinary shares and redeemable warrants bundled in the Units. Each Unit comprises one Class A share and one-third of one warrant, each whole warrant exercisable at $11.50 per share. Shares and warrants will trade on Nasdaq under TBCV and TBCVW; unseparated Units remain TBCVU. Separation requires broker contact with Continental Stock Transfer. Watch for warrant overhang, trust redemption dynamics, and any pending business combination.
